notes: Showcase mood: wear a Forge look on your portal, Night Knight first, with its live scene and readings.
Portals: five portals, one open at a time, each keeps its settings.
Forge looks drawn the way you laid them out: each card sized by its own content, so the text fills the box you draw, and a look's styles land on the right text.
Dia on USB screens: Dia Classic on the Thermalright pump screen and a round Dia on each Lian Li TL fan screen.
Smart weather words on every theme: the whole sky where it fits ("Mainly clear"), the word that names the weather where it does not.
